name: Oya Takashi Shuzo
about: Oya Takashi Shuzo is a sake brewery in Aikawa, in northwest Kanagawa, founded in 1830. Its origin goes back to the first Oya, a cavalry captain on the Hojo side at the 1569 Battle of Mimasetoge, who left the warrior's life after the battle and served as village head. Later the family took over a sake brewing licence from a brewer in Oiso and began making sake.

Since 2008 every sake has been junmai, with no added alcohol. The brewery makes two lines: Zaruso Hourai, started by the quick method, and Shoryu Hourai, started by kimoto. It draws underground water from the Tanzawa mountains from a well inside the building.
